# Revitalise Hub

> Revitalise Hub is a contrast therapy centre in Lymington, Hampshire (UK) offering ice baths, a traditional sauna and complimentary red light therapy. Sessions last one hour and can be booked as communal sessions (up to five guests) or private sessions for groups.

- Address: Unit 7, Ensign Yard, 670 Ampress Lane, Lymington, Hampshire SO41 8QY, United Kingdom
- Phone: 01590 698691 (+44 1590 698691)
- Email: info@revitalisehub.co.uk
- Opening hours: Tuesday–Saturday 8:30am–8:00pm, Sunday 8:30am–5:30pm, Monday closed
- Facilities: two ice baths (3–7°C), eight-person traditional sauna (85–90°C), red light therapy room, private changing rooms, on-site bathroom facilities, free parking
- Founded by Lewis and Tommy
- Serves Lymington, the New Forest and surrounding towns including Milford on Sea, Brockenhurst, New Milton and Christchurch

## Key pages

- [Book a session](https://www.revitalisehub.co.uk/booking): communal and private contrast therapy sessions
- [Memberships](https://www.revitalisehub.co.uk/memberships): monthly plans for regular visitors
- [Your visit](https://www.revitalisehub.co.uk/your-visit): what to expect, etiquette and session guidance for first-timers
- [Our hub](https://www.revitalisehub.co.uk/our-hub): facilities and location
- [Red light therapy](https://www.revitalisehub.co.uk/red-light-therapy): included with every session
- [Fitness & recovery](https://www.revitalisehub.co.uk/fitness-recovery): coaching package combining training with contrast therapy
- [Gift cards](https://www.revitalisehub.co.uk/gift-cards): digital gift cards from £10 to £500
- [Events](https://www.revitalisehub.co.uk/events): workshops such as hot yoga and breathwork with contrast therapy
- [Journal](https://www.revitalisehub.co.uk/blog): articles on cold water therapy, sauna, red light therapy and recovery
- [About](https://www.revitalisehub.co.uk/about) and [Contact](https://www.revitalisehub.co.uk/contact)

## Notes

Health information on this site is general and not medical advice. Anyone with a heart or circulation condition, high or low blood pressure, who is pregnant, or who has other health concerns should speak to their GP before trying cold water immersion or sauna.
